camel_example: aliyun maxcompute GET /api/v1/ai/artifacts --region cn-hangzhou --archived true --search '订单看板' --managedOnly true --conversationId '123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55' --nextToken 'eyJvZmZzZXQiOjUwfQ==' --maxResults 50 --type report --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the list of analysis artifacts for the current account with paging, and supports filtering by session and artifact type
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的分析产物列表，支持按会话和产物类型过滤
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-artifacts --conversation-id '123456789012****#cn-shanghai#1ee04bea-0488-46b6-b85b-827e3cd37e55' --type report --next-token eyJvZmZzZXQiOjUwfQ== --managed-only true --archived true --search '订单看板' --max-results 50 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListArtifacts

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by conversation ID to return only the artifacts generated in the specified conversation. If left empty, all artifacts of the current account are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按会话ID过滤，仅返回该会话产生的产物。留空时返回当前账号的全部产物
parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by artifact type. Valid values: dataset, table, chart, dashboard, report, sql, python, maxframe, and udf. If left empty, artifacts of all types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 产物类型过滤。取值：dataset（数据集）、table（表格）、chart（图表）、dashboard（仪表盘）、report（报告）、sql（SQL）、python（Python）、maxframe（MaxFrame）、udf（UDF）。留空时返回全部类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Leave this parameter empty for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response. If the returned nextToken is empty, no more data is available
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记。首次查询留空；后续查询传入上一次返回的nextToken。返回的nextToken为空时表示没有更多数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only managed dashboards. Default value: false. When set to true, you can use the archived parameter to filter the archive status of dashboards
parameters.help_zh: 是否只返回托管看板。默认 `false`。设置为 `true` 时可使用 `archived` 筛选看板归档状态
parameters.name: managed_only

parameters.help_en: The archive filter for managed dashboards. This parameter requires managedOnly to be set to true. Set to true to query archived dashboards, or false to query unarchived dashboards. If omitted, dashboards in both states are returned
parameters.help_zh: 托管看板的归档筛选条件，要求 `managedOnly=true`。`true` 查询已归档看板，`false` 查询未归档看板。省略时返回两种状态
parameters.name: archived

parameters.help_en: Queries records whose artifact titles contain the specified text. The maximum length is 200 characters. The filter conditions from the initial query are applied during pagination
parameters.help_zh: 按产物标题查询包含该文本的记录，最多 200 个字符。翻页时沿用首次查询的筛选条件
parameters.name: search

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of artifacts to return in the current request. Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 本次返回的最大产物条数。取值范围1~200，默认值50
parameters.name: max_results

data.description_en: The artifact list and pagination information

artifactId.description_en: The artifact ID. It uniquely identifies an analysis artifact
artifactId.description_zh: 产物ID，唯一标识一个分析产物

contentType.description_en: The MIME type of the artifact content, such as text/markdown, text/csv, or application/json

conversationId.description_en: The ID of the conversation in which the artifact was generated

conversationTitle.description_en: The title of the conversation in which the artifact was generated
conversationTitle.description_zh: 产生该产物的会话标题

createdAt.description_en: The time when the artifact was created. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 format, such as 2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z
createdAt.description_zh: 产物创建时间。UTC时间，RFC3339格式，例如2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z

metadata.description_en: The metadata of the artifact. The content varies based on the artifact type
metadata.description_zh: 产物元数据，内容随产物类型不同而不同

path.description_en: The relative storage path of the artifact file, which is used to retrieve the artifact content
path.description_zh: 产物文件的相对存储路径，用于获取产物内容

title.example: 近30天销售趋势分析报告

type.description_en: The artifact type. Valid values: dataset, table, chart, dashboard, report, sql, python, maxframe, and udf
type.description_zh: 产物类型。取值：dataset（数据集）、table（表格）、chart（图表）、dashboard（仪表盘）、report（报告）、sql（SQL）、python（Python）、maxframe（MaxFrame）、udf（UDF）

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the artifact was last updated. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the RFC 3339 format, such as 2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z
updatedAt.description_zh: 产物最近更新时间。UTC时间，RFC3339格式，例如2026-08-27T08:53:38.000Z

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求的最大返回条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. An empty string indicates that no more data is available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页标记。为空字符串时表示没有更多数据

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned to help identify the cause of the error
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回具体错误码，用于定位错误原因

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a human-readable error description is returned
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回可读的错误描述

httpCode.description_en: The business status code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned, such as 400, 403, 404, or 500
httpCode.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回对应的HTTP错误码，例如400、403、404、500

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It uniquely identifies the request and can be used for troubleshooting and log correlation
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，唯一标识本次请求，可用于问题排查与日志关联
